title: Write core worker execution dogfood plan
instructions:
Implement only Slice 5 of Core worker execution trust hardening: create a concise docs-only 20-run dogfood evidence plan at references/playbooks/core-worker-execution-dogfood.md.

Required content:
- Explain the purpose: judge Samantha core worker execution reliability from evidence, not architecture optimism.
- Define a 20-run dogfood plan for real Samantha work after Slices 1-4.
- Include metrics for task spec writing time, worker runtime, verification time, manual review time, retry/rework time, false pass count, false block count, timeout count, scope violation count, and task template reuse.
- Include review questions after 20 runs: whether Samantha reduced review time, whether task spec friction is too high, which task families fail most, whether verify command quality issues recur, and what templates are justified by evidence.
- Include stop conditions and non-goals: no dashboard, daemon/watch, remote adapter, multi-project orchestration, hidden memory, autonomous push, writerCap increase, broad batch expansion, or LLM semantic verification.
- Keep the document as an operational playbook, not roadmap doctrine and not an implementation backlog.

Do not change source code, tests, task specs, task templates, agent profiles, roadmap/doctrine docs, run logs, lifecycle state, package files, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, remote adapters, hidden memory, or orchestration scope. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
